title: Configuration Acceptance Bounds
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-state Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,s,C\in\mathbb N$. If $C\ge |Q|+6k+5$, where $Q$ is the state set of $M$, then the variable count of the CNF formula encoding acceptance is at most $C(s+n+1)$, and the length of its binary serialization is at most $4\bigl(C(s+n+1)+3\bigr)+1$.
hypotheses_covered: M is a finite-state Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
n, s, and C are natural numbers
C is at least the number of states of M plus 6k+5
